toeFinding.userReport: Second-outfit shoes and stockings on Layer 1 remove and height drops, but toe contortion remains until rest of outfit removed
toeFinding.cause: R02 measured stale owned toe local positions as the dominant contributor; fitted body toe region also differed from canonical barefoot. R03 restored owned toe positions and regenerated footwear-inactive candidate fits with the canonical barefoot region.

preAuthoringRemediation.R02MeasuredCause: Mask-1 fitted body/mesh creates ~0.0620113 m toe-region residual; canonical mesh substitution reduces it to 1.72855e-7 m. Transform restoration alone does not remove it. Footwear flags/lift/shrink are inactive at mask 1.
